[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
The current profile places Margaret’s birth before 12 April 1783, an uncertain bound compatible with a matching Edinburgh child transcript’s 9 April birth and 12 April baptism. The exact transcript date is recorded here while the structured vital remains unchanged pending review of the original register. The transcript names father Alexander Glasgow and mother Agnes Cunningham. Her current working father-profile identification with [[Glasgow-1321|Alexander Glasgow]] remains 59% possible. The catalogue retains attached mother [[Cunningham-20926|Agnes Cunningham]] as unassessed; the earlier draft’s [[Cunninghame-96|Agnes Cunninghame]] link is a separate prior claim, not resolved by the transcript.

May be the same person as [[Glasgow-518|Margaret Glasgow (abt.1788-1874)]], 5th cousin of M Glasgow.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-1321]] is assessed at 63% (probable). The Findmypast Scotland OPR derivative transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/0738380 (OPR 685_2/10 p347 item 2; record fmp-record-scot-opr-bap-0738380) gives Margaret Glasgow's birth on 9 Apr 1783 and baptism on 12 Apr 1783 at St Cuthberts, Edinburgh, to father Alexander Glasgow, a brewer's servant living at New Grange, and mother Agnes Cunningham. That is the catalogue couple: Alexander [[Glasgow-1321]] and his tree spouse Agnes (Cunningham) Glasgow, whose other children belong to the same 1774-1777 Edinburgh household. The 22 Oct 2026 assessment (59%, possible) rested on the generic OPR citation and said the absent literal fields left material uncertainty; those fields are now read and name exactly this father and mother. A 5 Jul 1847 St Cuthberts marriage index entry (Margaret Glasgow and James Edgar; ancestry-60144-2039929) also gives the bride's father as Alexander Glasgow. The raise is modest, to 63% (probable, the lower edge), because a child's baptism cannot show that this Edinburgh Alexander is the Kirknewton-born [[Alexander-1321]] (born before 1747) or choose between the two Agnes Cunningham profiles ([[Cunningham-20926]] and the draft [[Cunninghame-96]]).

Derivative transcript and a marriage index row only; the original register images are uninspected. The father is identified by name, trade and residence, not by age or parentage, and Alexander Glasgow is a common Edinburgh name. The 1847 marriage row names the father but nothing else about him. Mother, upstream ancestry and the Agnes Cunningham identity are assessed separately.
